text:
deploy-bot: RELEASE PAUSED: release/v1.12.3 -> prod
Reason: env-layer override detected. diff between staging/prod RBAC + secret scope. flagged by deploy checks.

olivia: taking this. pausing any manual promotions. :eyes:
sam: is this related to the env-layering change from infra PR #3198?
marco: yes, that PR introduced an optional env_layer_override that wires a rolebinding to a namespaced SA. it landed to staging yesterday.
jen: can someone paste the rolebinding output from staging and prod? need concrete diffs to rule out a false positive.
olivia: staging rolebinding (trimmed):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: inference-executor-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: inference-runner-staging
roleRef:
  name: inference-executor
```
prod (trimmed):
```
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: RoleBinding
metadata:
  name: inference-executor-binding
subjects:
- kind: ServiceAccount
  name: inference-runner-prod
roleRef:
  name: inference-executor
```
qa-carlos: staging tests passed but note: we mount `team-credentials` secret with `scope: team:staging` in the new chart; prod's secret exists but has `scope: team:prod` and the webhook that env-layering expects looks for `scope:team:staging`. mismatch could break admission that creates bindings.
sam: oh — so it's not the SA name alone, it's the secret-based admission path. that explains why rolebinding got created in staging but not in prod.
marco: confirmed: the admission webhook looks up secrets by `scope` label. staging has label `scope=team:staging` on the secret referenced by the chart; prod secret label stayed `scope=team:prod`.
olivia: options: 1) back out v1.12.3 (pin to v1.12.2) and perform a secret label & RBAC backfill in prod, or 2) patch prod secret label & trigger a manual reconcile then continue rollout.
jen: change window closes in 50m. recommended: rollback/pin now to avoid partial prod state, then schedule controlled patch + canary.
olivia: I'm going to pin release to v1.12.2 in the deploy pipeline and create a rollback commit.
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by olivia at 3309991135. Action: pin image to gcr/redwood/inference@sha256:abcd1234 and mark release/v1.12.3 as HOLD.
sam: I'll open infra PR to standardize secret label key to `env.scope` and add migration task list. also add a small smoke check in deploybot to compare secret labels across envs.
marco: I'll prepare the RBAC reconciliation playbook and a k8s job to backfill rolebindings if the secret label is corrected.
qa-carlos: after rollback completes, I'll run the staging-to-prod smoke to confirm no regressions.
elaine: (pm) updating release notes: roll forward blocked by env-layering RBAC+secret-scope parity. scheduling a follow-up canary next Wed in the next change window.
olivia: created issue INF-482: "env-layer override: prod secret label/RBAC parity and deploybot check" with links to the infra PR and RBAC playbook.
sam: adding quick lint to CI: on deploy, compare `kubectl get secret -l app=inference -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.labels}'` across envs and warn if `env.scope` or `scope` differs.
jen: thanks team. postmortem + migration plan please after we stabilize. marking this thread resolved once rollback completes and infra PR is merged. :white_check_mark:
